stage: POLARIS STAGE 8.16B-2 — FINAL CONTROL REPRODUCTION AUDIT

root_cause_analysis.primary_cause_id: Cause 8 / Cause 9: Stage 4 Parameter Source Mismatch
root_cause_analysis.description: Historical Stage 8.1 official evaluation (run_official_odd_evaluation.py) used globally frozen Stage 4 parameters from STAGE4_PARAMS_PATH (ensemble_parameters.json) without refitting on the EVEN split (STAGE 4 REFIT = NO). Stage 8.16B-2 validation script (run_stage8_16b_2_odd_validation.py) invoked fit_stage4_parameters(df_even), refitting Stage 4 parameters on the 174 EVEN training origins.
root_cause_analysis.verification_proof: When fit_stage4_parameters is replaced with globally frozen ensemble_parameters.json, the reconstructed Stage 8.1 Control daytime MAE matches 36.188657 W/m2 and nMAE matches 28.0688% EXACTLY to 6 decimal places.

phi_candidate_impact_analysis.conclusion: Under BOTH protocols (globally frozen Stage 4 and EVEN-refit Stage 4), the Phi candidate achieves a statistically significant held-out ODD improvement over Stage 8.1 Control of -0.4611 W/m2 (or -0.4960 W/m2) with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval strictly below zero.
